commits.notes: Real bug found: the rerolled XXH64_finalize uses `if (len > 4)` instead of `>= 4`, so for len%8==4 (4, 12, 20, 28, ...) the 4-byte step is skipped and bytes are processed one at a time -> different hash. Because XXH_REROLL_XXH64 is enabled automatically on 32-bit targets, XXH64() returned wrong hashes on i386/ARM32 by default (Alive2 value-mismatch counterexample; confirmed natively). Fixed upstream in ff9d808 ("Fixed rerolled version of 64-bit hash. Was wrong for length == 4 on 32-bit platforms"). Default 64-bit configuration and XXH32/XXH3 rerolls are equivalent on the checked lengths.
